column2:
Treatment focuses on restoring blood flow and stabilizing disease through PCI, stenting, surgery, or pharmacological therapy, with emerging robotic and precision solutions.


1) Lifestyle Modifications  (Non-procedural, foundation of CAD management)
•	Diet changes (low saturated fat, Mediterranean diet)
•	Regular exercise / cardiac rehab programs
•	Smoking cessation
•	Weight management
•	Stress reduction, psychosocial support
2) Pharmacotherapy (Medical Treatment)
•	Antiplatelets (Aspirin, P2Y12 inhibitors like Clopidogrel)
•	Statins (lipid-lowering)
•	Beta-blockers
•	ACE inhibitors / ARBs
•	Calcium channel blockers, Nitrates (anti-anginal)
•	Other lipid-lowering therapies (PCSK9 inhibitors, etc.)
3) Interventions (Catheter-Based / Minimally Invasive)
•	Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI)
•	Coronary Angioplasty (Balloon Angioplasty)
•	Drug-Eluting Stents / Nanoparticle Stents
•	Intravascular Lithotripsy (for calcified plaque)
•	Robotic-Assisted PCI
•	Brachytherapy (intracoronary radiation)
•	Cardiac Catheterization (diagnostic, often gateway to PCI)
4) Surgical Treatments
•	Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG)
•	Endarterectomy (plaque removal from artery wall)
